title: South Carolina National Guard responds to Hurricane Florence
description: Members of the South Carolina Army National Guard's 1053rd Transportation Company position unit vehicles in Manning, S.C., after refueling and picking up life jackets in preparation for potential high-water rescue missions in response to Hurricane Florence, Sept. 14, 2018. (U.S. Army National Guard video by South Carolina Army National Guard)

transcript.text: We were activated on Sunday to provide traffic control points and support to the Highway Patrol and local law enforcement during the initial phase of the operation
